name: Trinity Research Doctorate Awards (TRDA)
amount: €25,000/year stipend + EU or non-EU tuition fees, 4 years
dlText: 25 Jan 2027, 12:00 noon Irish time (PI / joint student-PI awards)
note: Joint student–supervisor applications under the PI-based category; separate TRDA Group studentships are recruited by successful PI teams after April 2027. Non-tuition charges are not covered.

name: UCD Ad Astra Doctoral Scholarships
amount: Typically €25,000/year tax-free stipend + fee waiver + €4,000/year research allowance, 4 years (varies by school)
dlText: Rolling – advertised by individual UCD schools, mostly early in the year

eligibility.note: Recent school adverts state EU and non-EU candidates are equally eligible; some schools cap fee cover – check each call.

note: Calls for 2027 entry not yet published at time of checking; 2026 calls were posted on school pages and the UCD Graduate Studies scholarships list.

name: Hardiman PhD Scholarships
dlText: Expected ~early Feb 2027, 17:00 Irish time (estimated from 2026 cycle: 6 Feb 2026); opens ~early Dec

eligibility.note: No nationality restriction stated; applicants must not already hold or be registered for a PhD. Confirm on the eligibility page.

fields: Any discipline (thematic areas set each round)
note: University of Galway's flagship internal PhD awards; the student levy, consumables and travel are not covered.

name: John & Pat Hume Doctoral Awards
amount: €25,000/year stipend + €2,000/year research expenses + EU fees, 4 years (non-EU fee waiver on request)
dlText: Expected ~late Jan 2027, 23:45 GMT (estimated from 2026 cycle: 23 Jan 2026); call opens ~Dec 2026

eligibility.note: Open to new full-time entrants; awards cover EU fees and successful non-EU applicants may apply for a non-EU fee waiver.

note: Secure commitment from a Maynooth supervisor before applying; stipend paid only while resident in Ireland.

name: RCSI StAR International PhD Programme
host: RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences
amount: PhD fees + annual stipend + research consumables (amount: check official page)
dlText: Recruitment through partner institutions at designated times; Fulbright route for 2027-28 closed 6 Oct 2026

eligibility.note: High-achieving international students recruited via partners (Qatar University, Sorbonne University, University of Pittsburgh, Fulbright Ireland-USA); each partner route has its own rules.

fields: Biomedical, clinical, population health and health services research
note: Joint international PhD split between RCSI Dublin and a partner; RCSI helps with accommodation and travel.

name: Insight Research Ireland Centre for Data Analytics – Funded PhD Positions
host: Insight Research Ireland Centre for Data Analytics
amount: Recent adverts: €25,000/year tax-free stipend + full tuition fees + travel and equipment
dlText: Rolling – each position has its own closing date

eligibility.note: Set per advert; recent Research Ireland centre PhDs have generally been open to EU and non-EU candidates – check each position.

note: Positions at partner universities (Galway, UCD, DCU, UCC and others); the 2025 neuro-symbolic AI scholarships were open to EU and non-EU candidates.

name: ADAPT Centre – Funded PhD Positions
host: ADAPT Research Ireland Centre for AI-Driven Digital Content Technology
amount: Stipend + fees (check each advert); MSCA doctoral posts in ADAPT pay a salary
dlText: Rolling – each position has its own closing date

eligibility.note: Set per advert; recent Research Ireland centre PhDs have generally been open to EU and non-EU candidates – check each position.

fields: AI, digital content, NLP, human-computer interaction
note: PhD posts are advertised on the ADAPT careers page by partner universities (TCD, DCU, UCD and others); none were listed at time of checking.

name: Lero – Funded PhD Positions
host: Lero, the Research Ireland Centre for Software
dlText: Rolling – each position has its own closing date

eligibility.note: Set per advert; recent Research Ireland centre PhDs have generally been open to EU and non-EU candidates – check each position.

fields: Software engineering, cyber-physical and autonomous systems
note: Vacancies are posted on the Lero careers page; Lero also accepts expressions of interest with a CV sent to the relevant researcher.

name: CONNECT Centre – Funded PhD Positions
host: CONNECT, the Research Ireland Centre for Future Networks
dlText: Rolling – each position has its own closing date

eligibility.note: Set per advert; recent Research Ireland centre PhDs have generally been open to EU and non-EU candidates – check each position.

fields: Telecommunications, wireless and future networks, IoT
note: Hosted at Trinity College Dublin with partner institutions; past CONNECT studentships were open to Irish, EU and international students.

name: AMBER Centre – Funded PhD Positions
host: AMBER, the Research Ireland Centre for Advanced Materials and BioEngineering Research
dlText: Rolling – each position has its own closing date

eligibility.note: Set per advert; recent Research Ireland centre PhDs have generally been open to EU and non-EU candidates – check each position.

note: Based at Trinity College Dublin; open positions are posted on the vacancies page and applications usually go directly to the PI.

name: Tyndall National Institute – PhD Studentships
amount: €22,000/year bursary + university fees paid by Tyndall
dlText: Rolling – each position has its own closing date

eligibility.note: Set per advert; recent Research Ireland centre PhDs have generally been open to EU and non-EU candidates – check each position.

note: Research Masters and PhD students at Tyndall (Cork) receive a bursary and have fees paid; studentships appear under 'Postgraduates, Studentships & Internships' on the careers page.
